doc: PIL.Image.resize(..., resample=BILINEAR) reference for cortex.resizeBilinearRGB's documented deviation check (cortex/vision_siglip_test.go TestResizeBilinearRGBVsPIL). Regenerate with: python -c "import numpy as np; from PIL import Image; rng=np.random.default_rng(0); src=(rng.random((37,41,3))*255).astype('uint8'); Image.fromarray(src,'RGB').resize((64,64),Image.BILINEAR)"
